citations.quote: The ratings upgrade most likely reflects a lower expected probability of default and/or a greater level of recovery of assets if default occurs.
We also present a model with stochastically varying spreads for different rating classes, which will become useful later in the chapter on interest-rate swaps.
In particular, the aggregate credit risk of a diverse portfolio of instruments is often not measured effectively.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Building blocks of credit risk: rating, default probability, recovery, credit spread - without yet entering reduced-form pricing. Decomposes the credit-spread risk premium into expected loss (PD x LGD) plus a risk premium for spread variation.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Credit Risk Fundamentals
